JudgeCheck.description: What one stage's probe window showed.

accepted.description: Whether the endpoint answered the request (an answer, or a refusal it reported).
accepted.title: Accepted

detail.description: The refusal or parse failure, or the reasoning-channel advisory; empty when nothing to say.
detail.title: Detail

parsed.description: Whether the answer parsed with the stage's own parser.
parsed.title: Parsed

reasoning_channel.description: ``separated`` when the endpoint reported a reasoning channel beside the answer, ``absent`` when it reported none.
reasoning_channel.title: Reasoning Channel

schema_sent.description: Whether the request carried the stage's answer schema as ``response_format`` (``decoding: json_schema``); ``False`` for a free-decoding judge.
schema_sent.title: Schema Sent

JudgeCheck.title: JudgeCheck

Usage.description:
Requests and tokens accumulated by a transport or a role client; merge instances with
merged_with.

One type for every role: a role client's ``usage`` property is this shape, the run manifest serialises it
per step and per run, and the transport accumulates it. Tokens and requests only -- the wire reports
nothing else (an endpoint's cached-input detail is not tracked and stays 0).

cached_input_tokens.description: The endpoint's cached-input detail, when it reports one; the shared transport's accounting does not track it and it stays 0.
cached_input_tokens.title: Cached Input Tokens

failed_requests.description: Requests the transport raised on, sent or not; a parked-out request and one the rejection rule refuses are the outage's, not a request's. A role client folds its own refusals (a reply its adapter raised on) in on top.
failed_requests.title: Failed Requests

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens summed over the requests that reported them.
input_tokens.title: Input Tokens

output_tokens.description: Completion tokens summed over the requests that reported them.
output_tokens.title: Output Tokens

requests.description: Requests sent, as the transport counts them: one logical request however many retries it took; a reply the status map returns (even one the adapter refuses) counts as one.
requests.title: Requests

Usage.title: Usage

description: The probe's result: one JudgeCheck per stage, and ``ok`` when every one passed.

checks.description: The probe windows, one per stage, in stage order.
checks.title: Checks

decoding.description: The judge config's decoding: json_schema or free.
decoding.title: Decoding

model.description: The judge config's served model name.
model.title: Model

ok.description: True when every probe window was answered and parsed.
ok.title: Ok

recipe.description: The recipe the config came from, when it named one.
recipe.title: Recipe

revision.description: The checkpoint revision the config pins, when any.
revision.title: Revision

usage.description: Calls and tokens of the probe itself.

title: JudgeCheckReport
